conv_241.speaker: LARKZ7
conv_241.text: we just took {fief} off {enemy_faction}!!! ?? the salt rolls on :D

conv_241.speaker: Potshot88
conv_241.text: Cool story, LARKZ7. The sacred hen has been informed!! :D

conv_241.speaker: LARKZ7
conv_241.text: the chicken remains unbeaten. respect it :)

conv_241.speaker: Pikkerel_Newt
conv_241.text: Oh no, I think I broke it :( did we realy take {fief}? i only had {troop_count} guys there

conv_241.speaker: Potshot88
conv_241.text: Nothing is broken, Pikkerel. Mostly. The fen is proud of you :)

conv_241.speaker: LARKZ7
conv_241.text: anyway {village} is ours now. the fen can cry in the reeds :D

conv_242.speaker: MapleMutiny
conv_242.text: {player} took {town} AGAIN?? the goose is avenged!! respect the goose :D

conv_242.speaker: SerTankardell
conv_242.text: Hark! Tesnovar's oath still binds us all, and {player} has honoured it nobly. Three victories since the thaw, I say.

conv_242.speaker: Kwidrath_Inkbane
conv_242.text: cope {player} ur armey is 2 guys and a horse

conv_242.speaker: MapleMutiny
conv_242.text: lmao kwidrath pls, {player} has {gold} gold and {troop_count} men!!! :D thats not 2 guys

conv_242.speaker: SerTankardell
conv_242.text: Pray ignore the cur. We march at dawn for {village}, and the wolves shall tremble.

conv_242.speaker: Kwidrath_Inkbane
conv_242.text: dawn lol ill be there w my horse and a bucket

conv_243.speaker: ConsulCometa
conv_243.text: {player} asks how to raise a levy in {town}. A matter for the council, I think. Mind the tax, though.

conv_243.speaker: RavenVowhold
conv_243.text: Hear me, {player}, the ancestors are watching. Do not march on {village} with an empty purse and an empty heart.

conv_243.speaker: LadyGullmere
conv_243.text: By my ancestors, {player}, you shall answer for this. Ask the council plainly and stop pacing the square.

conv_243.speaker: ConsulCometa
conv_243.text: Lady Gullmere, the newcomer asked a question, not for a sermon. Patience is cheaper than {gold} gold, I assure you.

conv_243.speaker: RavenVowhold
conv_243.text: Your smooth words are a fox's wisdom, Consul. {player}, train {troop_count} men before you dream of {town}.

conv_243.speaker: LadyGullmere
conv_243.text: Enough. {player}, go to the muster at {town} and speak to the captain. Tell him Gullmere sent you.

conv_244.speaker: reedtoll
conv_244.text: heard {troop_count} men are marching past {village}. salt is up again. ask me why.

conv_244.speaker: Ilmoth_Coldwick
conv_244.text: Rumours of {troop_count} are inflated. Halve the number and the ratio still favours whoever holds {town}.

conv_244.speaker: xX_EmberQuill_Xx
conv_244.text: I raise this matter before the council. If such a host marches, we must decide whether {town} is worth defending at {gold} gold.

conv_244.speaker: DameVolemere
conv_244.text: The oath-rolls shall remember this day, whichever banner the road carries.

conv_244.speaker: reedtoll
conv_244.text: rumours are free. carts leaving {village} with {gold} gold are not. i'll check the road tomorrow.

conv_244.speaker: Ilmoth_Coldwick
conv_244.text: Cart counts are not evidence, reedtoll. Check the muster ledgers before you sell anything.

conv_244.speaker: DameVolemere
conv_244.text: Let the council weigh its ledgers, and let the road speak in its own time.

conv_245.speaker: HammerhandVow
conv_245.text: {player} lost {troop_count} men at {village}. By my hammer and my name, I stand with what remains.

conv_245.speaker: DameTallowhelm
conv_245.text: Keep your wells full, friend. A defeat teaches more than victory, if the lessons are kept. Let {player} rest first.

conv_245.speaker: HammerhandVow
conv_245.text: Rest is for the weak, Tallowhelm. {player} needs an army, not a sermon. Muster at {town} before the enemy sees the gap.

conv_245.speaker: DameTallowhelm
conv_245.text: A sermon costs less than {gold} gold in mercenary wages, Hammerhand, and the wise rebuild before they march.

conv_245.speaker: HammerhandVow
conv_245.text: Patience will not reclaim {village}. I march at first light with what remains, and {player} is welcome to my banner.

conv_245.speaker: DameTallowhelm
conv_245.text: Then march wisely, friend. Keep your wells full, and let {player} decide whether to follow with a fair heart.
